title: Introduce a Classmate and a Study Item

instructions: 按步骤先列关键词，再写自己的短句；参考示例不能作为自己的提交。
prompt: Write 80–100 words in short sentences. Introduce yourself and one fictional classmate. Describe a study item and ask for help. Use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作步骤提示
guidedOutput.text: 先列出自己的名字、同学、一件学习物品及数量；每一步先写一两句短句，再连成完整内容。加入一句礼貌请求（Please ...）和互相帮助的方式；最后检查至少六个本课词。

reference: My name is Sara. I am a student in an English group. This is Ben. He is my classmate. We meet at ten. I have a notebook and a textbook. Ben has a marker. Please open your notebook, Ben. I can show you a short note. There are three names on it. I have a question about one name. Ben, can you help me spell it? We speak again and check our work with the teacher. We do not need to be fast. Thank you for your help, Ben. I am fine in this small group.
referenceLabel: 原创 AI 示例，仅供学习，不是已完成的作品。
